Name: Type
Description: Selects which axis the input is mirrored across.

Flubs.Name: X
Flubs.Description: Flips the input horizontally (mirrors along the X axis).

Flubs.Name: Y
Flubs.Description: Flips the input vertically (mirrors along the Y axis).

Flubs.Name: XY
Flubs.Description: Flips both axes (180° mirror of the input).
